title: Event Overlap
summary: Lists what a new or moved calendar event runs into and moves it to the nearest free slot, so meetings aren't booked on top of each other.
description: Lists clashes (overlaps, back-to-back with no break, too little travel time between places, busy all-day events, other-zone events in their own time) on a small timeline, and moves the event to the nearest slot that keeps your buffer and travel time, with Undo.
catches: Overlapping events and busy all-day events
Too little travel time between places
Events in other time zones, shown in their own local time
The nearest free slot within work hours, with Undo
limits: Only knows the events you pass; other calendars are unseen
Travel times come from your data
a11y: The timeline is aria-hidden; clashes are listed in text
Move and Undo are buttons with visible text
stops: Meeting booked on top of another
